title: Password and token block properties render in cleartext in the Flow Canvas Properties panel and are matchable via canvas search
existing_state: Block schemas define secret-bearing props as plain text: sftp 'password' Override (FlowCanvas/src/blockDefs/registry.ts:119) and http 'password'/'token' (registry.ts:368-369). PropertyField renders all text-type props as <input type="text"> (FlowCanvas/src/panels/Properties.tsx:782-798), so selecting one of these blocks shows the credential in cleartext in the right rail. The app already treats these keys as secrets elsewhere — the on-canvas block summary masks exactly 'password' and 'token' with bullets (FlowCanvas/src/utils/blockSummary.ts:10, 64-70) — creating a false sense that secrets are hidden. Additionally, Ctrl+F search matches against JSON.stringify(props) (FlowCanvas/src/stores/slices/uiSlice.ts:226-243), so secret VALUES are part of the search haystack (a query matching part of a password highlights the block).
recommendation: In PropertyField, render props whose key is in the shared SECRET_KEYS set (import it from blockSummary.ts so the two stay aligned) as type="password" with a small eye/reveal toggle; in uiSlice.setSearchQuery, build the props haystack from non-secret keys only (or keys-plus-non-secret-values).
user_benefit: Credentials stop being displayed on screen during screen shares or over-the-shoulder viewing whenever a block is selected, matching the masking the canvas card already promises.

evidence.note: Text case renders a plain type="text" input — no password masking
Same keys are bullet-masked on the canvas card — masking intent already established
Search haystack includes JSON.stringify(props) — secret values are searchable

mockup_idea: Side-by-side of the http block's Properties panel: before — Password field showing 'hunter2' in a plain input; after — bullets with an eye-icon reveal toggle, matching the bullet masking already shown on the collapsed block card next to it.
